Class SafeFiles

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.SafeFiles
public final class SafeFiles extends Object
Saving that survives a crash or a power cut in the middle of a save. A save writes the new text to name.tmp, makes sure it is on the disk, keeps the old file as name.bak, then puts the new one in its place. Whatever moment the server stops, a complete copy is left: the file, the new copy or the backup.

load(Path, SafeFiles.Parser) reads the newest complete copy. If it cannot be read (damaged by something else, or edited by hand with a mistake), the damaged file is kept as name.broken-<time> for an admin and the backup is used.
